notes.title: Closed Beta Test Update

New feature


[b]Rookie Event
[/b]
The Rookie event is available only for new players who start the game for the first time and will consist of 12 matches, with the goal to get all new players together in one match.

In the event that there are not enough players to start a Rookie match, then the first available NON rookie players can backfill should they wish to. *However, the rewards are given only to NEW players starting the game for the first time. If you are an existing player joining the Rookie Event, then this is your time to shine as a Blockhead and help new players to understand how to play.

The Battlepass has 12 steps for each match. Players get rewards only for finished matches whether they win or lose.

Rewards for the event:
[/list]
[*]Razer's unique weapon skin ("Boy Scout")
[*]Profile tokens.
[*]Profile badges.
[*]“Ace of Spades” keychain.
[*]Unique skin Razer “Boy Scout”
[*]Boosters.
[/list]
